environment_lock.note: Exact reference dependencies; installed backend versions recorded separately

met_bundle_provenance.pool_crust_hot_source: plume2d uses the Excelsior reach temperature after pool-to-river mixing, not the pool interior temperature; pool_crust temperatures stay in pool_shells.json (illustrative by design)
met_bundle_provenance.surface_budget_wiring: explicit surface budget runs in hindcast/observed_replay when the met bundle carries night_air_c, humidity, cloud, and wind_xz_mps; otherwise Newton stays (illustrative by design)

chloride_validation_bound.note: Midway-only source flux is a bound on the between-gauge chloride increment; other basins between the gauges are not modeled

metrics.fipy_reference_skip_reason: fipy not installed; install the fipy extras group to run the dispersion and MMS references

groundwater_exchange.reason: no hydro.groundwater.cells configured; the head-gradient exchange needs per-cell bed conductivity, thickness, width, length, aquifer and river heads, and an aquifer temperature

mats.note: validation only; never feeds back into model parameters

solutes.note: Midway-only source flux is a bound on the between-gauge chloride increment; other basins between the gauges are not modeled

random_streams.generator: stdlib random.Random, no global numpy RNG in build path

restart.support: split-run same process; fresh object under constant forcing

shared_forcing.forcing_match: reach summaries and ecology consume mapped replay forcing
shared_forcing.replay_forcing_source: weather_frag with the resolved air time series

initial_state_preparation.patch_biomass_role: authored initial-state preparation before snow/soil spin-up
initial_state_preparation.river_geometry_forcing_role: prescribed mean rates and diagnostic initialization

timeline.t0: identified initial state after snow/soil spin-up
timeline.wildlife_reference: timings from declared hydrology window; snow and soil spin-up precede experiment
